Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Prosecution drops all cases vs Sara Duterte except unexplained wealth

blocks.text: The impeachment court accepts the prosecution’s move to withdraw all but one of the articles of impeachment against Vice President Sara Duterte.

items: Impeachment court lifts sub judice rule on withdrawn charges vs Sara Duterte

blocks.text: The Senate impeachment court lifts the sub judice rule on three withdrawn impeachment articles against Vice President Sara Duterte.

items: Sandiganbayan slaps Jinggoy Estrada with new 90-day suspension order

blocks.text: The anti-graft court Sandiganbayan delivers another 90-day preventive suspension order for Senator Jinggoy Estrada over his alleged involvement in a flood control project scandal.

items: House passes P7.2-trillion 2027 budget amid pork barrel concerns

blocks.text: The House of Representatives passed the proposed P7.2-trillion national budget for 2027 on third and final reading on Monday, October 12.

items: Pope Leo to enter hospital for surgery on lung nodule

blocks.text: Pope Leo is scheduled for surgery on October 13 to remove a small growth on one of his lungs. – Rappler.com
